_comment: Copy this file to appsettings.Production.json (gitignored) and fill in real values. Never commit real secrets.

_notes.Jwt.Secret: Leave blank — the server generates and persists a strong per-install key to data/jwt.key on first boot.
_notes.TMDB_API_KEY: Get a free v3 key from https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api
_notes.LICENSE_SERVER_API_KEY: Server-to-server API key for the WatchNexus license server. Never expose this to users. Rotate after any accidental commit.
_notes.PATCH_REPO_URL: GitHub API base URL for your patch/update repo (the repo that contains Patches/ and Updates/ folders).
_notes.PATCH_REPO_TOKEN: GitHub fine-grained PAT with read-only contents permission on the patch repo. Optional if repo is public.
_notes.PATCH_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY: Ed25519 public key (base64) used to verify patch manifests. Generate with: dotnet run --project src/watchnexus/tools/sign-manifest -- generate-keypair
